notes.title: Fish Levels Patch
notes.content: Making the Fish levels a bit easier after the last rework

notes.title: Patch Notes - August 2022
notes.content:
[h2]Content updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Neutral pronoun from "it" to "they" and dialogue adjustments
[*]More helpful hints in general
[*]Update Game Icon
[/list]
[h2]Fish incarnation Gameplay rework[/h2]
[list]
[*]Faster and more dynamic
[*]Level design rework with better mechanics introductions
[*]Update difficulty pacing and add more challenges variety
[*]Enemies don't kill each other before being tackled
[/list]
[h2]Many improvements and quality of life changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Some Amoeba and Planaria levels update
[*]Game keeps running on background
[*]Player identification arrow on Hub, and arrow follows player position
[*]Controls button to show Control Inputs in every level for every incarnation
[*]Fix and update social links buttons
[/list]
[h2]Some bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Amoeba Incarnation: on challenge level, the faster shooter were not shooting sometimes. Now fixed
[*]Spider Incarnation: ants used to enter a loop when two parallel web lines ware close. Now fixed
[*]Penguin Incarnation: removed "w" key for jump as It was messing with jump count.
[/list]

notes.title: Typos and small bugfixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix some typos
[*] Separate Hint and Health UI panel into two panels
[*] Fix Amoeba immediate suck after spit glitch
[*] Fix Penguin death animation while freezing
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfixes and improvements
notes.content:
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Controls input explanation rework with animation for a better onboard
[*] More helpfull hints
[*] Soul faster on incarnation hub (void)
[*] Boss: no grid snap, floating stones and death indicator
[*] Boss: levels balancing and change wall colors
[*] Incarnations 4 and 5 controls update
[*] Focus challenge levels on unlock
[*] Player position indicator on level start
[*] Minor level updates
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Incarnation 2 levels 3 and 4 check-mark progression order
[*] Update check-mark progression on level complete
[*] Sound configurations save to preferences
[/list]
